name: Sharvin Batwal
player_statement:
A complete player, Sharvin Batwal has made a big mark in cricket. With 27 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 24*, with an average of 10.31 and a quick strike rate of 50.95. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 2 sixes and 8 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 106.3 overs, taking 33 wickets at an economy rate of 6.19. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
